llm.summary: The skill is a coherent Youzan read connector, but its fallback setup tells the agent to run remote installer scripts directly, which users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: The declared tool access is limited to Bash commands matching oo *, and the skill instructs schema lookup before action execution, but the connector can access sensitive account data once the user is connected.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes curl-to-bash and PowerShell irm-to-iex installer commands for the oo CLI without checksum or signature verification and without an explicit approval step before local code execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation wording is broad for any Youzan request, but the runtime instructions narrow actual use to the Youzan connector, schema inspection, and the listed read actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install background services or persistence itself; normal CLI installation, login, and OOMOL connection state may persist as part of setup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is purpose-aligned for reading/searching Youzan shop, item, order, logistics, refund, and inventory data through an OOMOL-connected account; that data can include sensitive commerce and customer records.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust OOMOL and are comfortable giving the connector access to your Youzan account data. Before using the first-time setup commands, prefer a verified installer or official install instructions, and review any fetched script before execution. Treat order, refund, and logistics results as sensitive business/customer data.
llm.findings:
[SC2] expected: Installing the oo CLI is relevant to using the connector, but the documented direct remote-script execution is a material setup concern because it executes fetched code without integrity verification.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger language is partly consistent with a service-specific connector skill, but it should be read as limited to Youzan read/search tasks and not as authority for unrelated Youzan mentions or account changes.
